subject: QBR playbook: outstanding asks, owners, and sprint follow-ups
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah@opencanvas.com>
Cc: procurement@datacloud.com
Date: Thu, 08 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR playbook: outstanding asks, owners, and sprint follow-ups

Team — putting a short, prioritized list together from this morning's sync + the exec asks we need closed before the QBR (two weeks out). Goal: clear owners and realistic ship dates so we can show progress in the QBR playbook. I've attached the latest playbook and the mutual action plan template.

Top open asks (short):
- Product ask: final decision on model routing policy for latency-sensitive tier (owner: Karthik) — requirement: measurable 95th p99 latency target and fallback variants.
- Pricing/T&C: confirm whether we can extend 90-day trial credits for OpenCanvas pilot (owner: Marissa) — need guidance for finance.
- Compliance: customer asked for sample audit log export format (owner: Kimberly) — deliverable: sample CSV + retention policy text.

Immediate next steps (please reply with owner confirm / ETA in-line):
1) Karthik — routing policy decision and proposed config (ETA Wed 3/14)
2) Marissa — trial credit proposal + recommended language to procurement (ETA Mon 3/12)
3) Kimberly — audit log sample + one-paragraph retention note (ETA Tue 3/13)

External asks: Sarah (OpenCanvas) — they asked for a mutual action plan and a final decision on latency profile by 3/15. I copied procurement@datacloud.com because they want the trial terms clarified before procurement begins.

If there are any blockers (dependencies on infra, legal, or dedicated capacity), call them out in replies. Short replies preferred.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_QBR_playbook_v3.pdf (pdf, 2.4MB), OpenCanvas_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@opencanvas.com>, procurement@datacloud.com
Date: Thu, 08 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: outstanding asks, owners, and sprint follow-ups

Vivek — confirming I own the routing decision. Quick note on the technical trade-offs:
- Option A: strict region + latency routing to smaller model variant (lower cost, sub-5ms inference on 8k context but degrades generation richness)
- Option B: optimistic routing with prioritized GPU pools + KV cache (higher cost, preserves quality)

I'll run a short eval on live traffic samples and return a recommended policy with concrete 95th/99th latency projections and cost delta. Target ETA: 2028-03-14 EOD.

Blocker: need the latest token distribution sample from the pilot traffic (Sarah — can you confirm you can share a sanitized sample by EOD Fri?). If not, I'll use historical traces from our sandbox and mark the recommendation as conservative.

- Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

On Thu, Mar 8, 2028 at 09:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — putting a short, prioritized list together from this morning's sync + the exec asks we need closed before the QBR...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@opencanvas.com>, procurement@datacloud.com
Date: Fri, 09 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: outstanding asks, owners, and sprint follow-ups

Vivek / team — I will take the trial credit ask. Quick plan:
- Recommend 60-day pilot credit (instead of 90) tied to performance milestones (two successful runs + latency within agreed profile).
- I'll draft the procurement language and a short commercial note for the playbook.

ETA: draft to internal legal/finance Monday 3/12 EOD.

Note: we should be explicit about overage billing if pilot runs exceed projected tokens — I'll include a sample billing scenario in the doc.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success & GTM

On Thu, Mar 8, 2028 at 11:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Vivek — confirming I own the routing decision...
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@opencanvas.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: outstanding asks, owners, and sprint follow-ups

Vivek — I will own the audit log sample. Deliverables and plan:
- Deliver a one-page sample CSV with fields: timestamp, request_id, model_version, route, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, user_id (hashed).
- Include a short retention summary: default 90 days; enterprise option configurable (30/90/365) — note legal needs to sign off if >365.

ETA: sample CSV + retention blurb by Tue 3/13 EOD. Attaching a small stub in this reply.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance

Attachments in reply: audit_log_sample_stub.csv (csv, 5KB)

On Fri, Mar 9, 2028 at 08:22 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Vivek / team — I will take the trial credit ask...
From: Sarah Liu <sarah@opencanvas.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 13:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: outstanding asks, owners, and sprint follow-ups

Thanks all — appreciate the clarity. Quick responses:
- Sanity check: we can share a sanitized sample trace (no PII) by EOD Thu 3/15.
- 60-day pilot credit is fine as long as it maps to milestone check-ins; procurement will prefer the shorter window.
- Audit log sample looks good — happy to review the CSV schema once you send it.

One ask from my side: can you add a short section to the playbook that calls out the rollback/fallback behavior if latency deviates from the agreed SLO during the pilot? Procurement wants clarity on what the customer-facing behavior will be.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform Partnerships
OpenCanvas
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah@opencanvas.com>, procurement@datacloud.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: outstanding asks, owners, and sprint follow-ups

Quick status update ahead of the QBR:
- Karthik: routing policy recommendation received this morning. He proposes Option B with prioritized GPU pools + a fallback to smaller variant after 150ms. Karthik, please add the precise p95/p99 numbers to the playbook (file updated in Drive).
- Marissa: draft trial credit language sent to legal/finance; procurement informed — thanks.
- Kimberly: audit log sample and retention blurb received and added to the playbook (nice work).
- Sarah: thanks for commit on traffic sample by EOD today — that will let Karthik finalize numbers.

Action items remaining (final sprint):
1) Karthik: finalize numbers in Drive + short runbook for fallback (ETA Fri 3/15 6pm)
2) Marissa: confirm commercial wording in mutual action plan (ETA Mon 3/18)
3) Kimberly: legal sign-off note on retention >365 days if customer requests (ETA Mon 3/18)

I'll fold these into the QBR slide deck tomorrow morning and circulate to execs. If anything slips, flag it in this thread.

Thanks — Vivek
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
